current_experience: A banner urging them to register as a 'New User' appears immediately after the page loads, despite an existing active account being detected.
impact: Creates doubt about account validity, leading to duplicate registrations and user confusion.
sympho_solution: Single, honest authentication state. If an active session or credentials are found, show a dashboard shortcut and hide all registration banners.

current_experience: In the master services list table, the 'link to apply' column is identical for all 100+ services and redirects to the homepage instead of the form.
impact: Users must restart navigation from scratch, doubling application time and creating frustration.
sympho_solution: Direct deep-linking. Every service card in the catalog points to its specific wizard endpoint (/services/[slug]/apply).

current_experience: 500+ services are listed alphabetically by internal code, paginated 10 at a time, forcing citizens to scan long pages.
impact: Highly common services (like Community/Income) are buried, making discovery slow and error-prone.
sympho_solution: Search-as-you-type bar and intent-based grouping (e.g., 'I need a certificate') as the default landing view, prioritizing high-traffic services.

current_experience: Several services list document requirements as 'NA' or have incomplete document information.
impact: Citizens cannot prepare documents in advance, leading to rejected applications and wasted time.
sympho_solution: Strict schema validation for services. Every service must define a specific required/optional document array visible before the application starts.

current_experience: The 'Citizen Charter' sidebar link opens a static PDF from 2015, which is over a decade old and unrevised.
impact: Citizens read incorrect processing timelines and commitments that may no longer be accurate.
sympho_solution: Maintained HTML-based policy pages. Display the last audited SLA dates directly next to service turnaround descriptions.

current_experience: Citizens check application status across three different URLs depending on the channel originally used.
impact: Users check the wrong page, believe their application is lost, and flood customer support.
sympho_solution: Unified application tracking timeline. A single lookup page (/applications/[id]) maps the entire workflow clearly.
